facts.fact: The NIR director said a memorandum of understanding signed with the Civil Service Agency requires every government employee to have a national identification number before being placed on the payroll.
The National Identification Registry, whose director said it assigns a unique identification number to each resident, had enrolled 723,000 people by August 2024.
